My Account Account Settings Manage Subscriptions. # How DC plans can combine the best of active and passive. :   * Many DC plans are moving beyond an active/passive binary, exploring investment options that combine excess return potential, low tracking error, and lower fees. * Amid concerns over index risks and market volatility, strategies that pair active and passive qualities can be appealing alternatives to passive‑only options. Heightened market volatility, extreme index concentration, and acute fee pressures are driving many DC plan sponsors, advisors, and consultants to reevaluate the role of active and passive styles, both in terms of their return potential and the investment experience they provide to participants.
